objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the dermatological lesion observed on the patient's forehead.

fragments.text: The patient presents for an annual examination and mentions noticing a pink bump on his forehead that has developed over the last month. He reports significant sun exposure throughout his life, including episodes of blistering sunburns.
Rapid development over the last month
History of extensive sun exposure and multiple blistering sunburns. No significant past dermatological diagnoses.
Retired, spends a lot of time outdoors. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.
Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite. No other skin lesions noted.

exam_leaves.text: A 2 cm dome-shaped plaque with a central keratin plug located on the forehead.
The lesion is firm to touch, non-tender, and well-demarcated.
Not provided in the patient brief but recommended for assessment.

test_leaves.text: Exophytic nodule with central invagination filled with keratin.
